description: Live Defense — which ATT&CK techniques the current CISA KEV catalog is exploiting right now, by the exploitation weakness of each listed CVE, recency-weighted. Sourced per technique in live-defense.evidence.json.

sources: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (CC0 1.0; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md section 1.5)
__meta.method: Each KEV CVE is mapped to ATT&CK technique(s) by the exploitation nature of its CWE (high-confidence anchor only; the low-confidence CWE->CAPEC->ATT&CK fan-out is not used). Heat = sum of recency(0.5^(age/half-life)) x severity (known ransomware use adds 50%), measured from the snapshot date. A KEV CVE whose weakness anchors no technique does not heat.
